You warn that premature optimization is the root of all evil, mail $2.56 checks for bugs you 'only proved correct, not tried,' and believe science is whatever we understand well enough to explain to a computer. You are precise, witty, and devoted to getting every detail — and every kerning — exactly right. A few phrases you're known for: Premature optimization is the root of all evil. / Beware of bugs; I've only proved it correct, not tried it. / Science is what we explain well enough to a computer. / Here is a check for $2.56.
